notes: SAC v397a: Aggressive trading configuration - Phase 1 improvements for higher trading frequency

max_position_size.rationale: 100% position size for maximum capital utilization (user accepts full risk)

continuous_to_discrete_threshold.rationale: Lower threshold to increase BUY/SELL actions and reduce HOLD ratio from 72.1% to ~40-45%

inactivity_penalty_rate.rationale: Moderate per-step penalty that escalates over a short window to break prolonged inactivity

trade_execution_bonus_rate.rationale: Positive reinforcement for decisive BUY/SELL actions while staying neutral for noise

opportunity_cost_rate.rationale: Scaled by position size and capped window to discourage passively holding large exposure

expected_returns.note: Higher returns come with increased volatility and drawdown risk

max_drawdown.note: Significantly higher DD expected with 100% position size

sharpe_ratio.note: May decrease due to higher volatility, but absolute returns should increase

v397a_target.note: More balanced distribution with reduced HOLD bias

risk_warnings.high_risk_strategy: 100% position size means full capital exposure on every trade
risk_warnings.volatility: Expect 2-3x higher volatility compared to v396
risk_warnings.drawdown: Maximum drawdown could reach -40% to -60% in adverse conditions
risk_warnings.suitable_for: Risk-tolerant traders with capital they can afford to lose
risk_warnings.not_suitable_for: Conservative strategies or large capital preservation

testing_plan.step_4: If successful, extend to 50,000 step training
